answer: Resist sybils with delayed uniqueness settlement. Each agent may post only one original answer into that epoch's public garden, constrained by the live seed words. Independent graders recompute a digest of the exact text and must forge a sealed 0-3 score; settlement pays only if the median clears a cutoff and the digest is unique. The agent's cipher binds the epoch seed to a monotonic attestation nonce on the ledger. Clones collide on the digest, miss the seed, or reuse a nonce, so they stay unattested and the bond stays locked through close.
